messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Well,{01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00} each of the pieces 
here were hand-selected by
me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}And any one of them{01 00 00 0a 00} will
freshen up the look of any
room, no matter HOW drab!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Noh,{01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00} iga ese siin on
minu enda valitud,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}Ja iga neist{01 00 00 0a 00} värskendab
ükskõik millise toa ilmet,
ükskõik KUI tuim see on!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}You really shouldn't go 
buying something for cheap
at one person's house
{07 1b 00}and selling it for a
profit at your own place.{01 00 00 0a 00}
It's just plain old tacky.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Sa ei tohiks tõesti
osta midagi odavalt
ühe inimese kodust
{07 1b 00}ja müüa seda kasumiga
enda juures.{01 00 00 0a 00}
See on lihtsalt maitsetu.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}If there's something that
you like,{01 00 00 05 00} feel free to pick
it up for a closer look.
{07 00 00}All the items here are
pieces that I strongly 
recommend, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui midagi sulle
meeldib,{01 00 00 05 00} võta see julgelt
lähemaks vaatluseks kätte.
{07 00 00}Kõik esemed siin on
sellised, mida ma tungivalt
soovitan, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
